title: The Quiet Page
author: 필사독서 예문
text:
A book waits without asking anything of us. We open it at our own pace, bringing the day and all its scattered thoughts to the first page.

Sometimes the smallest sentence stays with us the longest. Reading it once may be enough to understand its meaning. Typing it slowly helps us notice its shape, its pauses, and its quiet rhythm.

There is no need to rush to the final chapter. Make room for a single paragraph. Let one line turn into another, and let your attention settle where the words are.

When the page is complete, look away from the screen for a moment. Remember one sentence you want to carry into tomorrow. That is a good place to begin again.
